w1_events.canonical_summary: Micron's analyst response episode extended through September 29 as JPMorgan, Wedbush and other analysts refreshed targets, earnings expectations, SCA coverage, memory-price views, HBM supply assumptions and FY2027 outlooks ahead of the FY2026 fourth-quarter release.

facts.proposition: Citi analyst Atif Malik warned that memory-chip prices could peak earlier than expected in the current memory-price cycle.
Wolfe Research estimated that Micron could generate sufficient free cash flow in calendar 2026 and 2027 to repurchase shares equivalent to approximately 25% of its market capitalization.
Wolfe Research rated Micron Outperform in its memory-sector research note.
UBS forecast that Micron should remain resilient under a scenario in which open-market memory prices fall approximately 80% at the end of the cycle beginning in the second half of 2028.
facts.subject_time: End-of-cycle scenario beginning in the second half of calendar 2028

facts.proposition: UBS forecast that Micron's trough annualized EPS would remain higher than the annualized EPS level implied by its next-quarter guidance.
facts.subject_time: End-of-cycle trough compared with next-quarter guidance

facts.proposition: Wells Fargo analyst Aaron Rakers lowered the Micron Technology price target from $1,525 to $1,400 and maintained an Overweight rating.
Citi analyst Atif Malik raised the Micron Technology price target from $1,150 to $1,300 and maintained a Buy rating.

Zacks Investment Research identified Micron and NVIDIA as important contributors to technology-sector earnings growth in 2026 Q3 and estimated that excluding Micron, NVIDIA and Alphabet would reduce sector earnings growth from 41.9% to 20.5%.
Wall Street analysts estimated Micron's FY2026 Q4 revenue at approximately $50.9 billion, up about 350% year over year.
Wall Street analysts estimated Micron's FY2026 Q4 EPS at approximately $31.49, up about 939% year over year.
Wall Street analysts projected Micron's FY2027 Q1 revenue at approximately $56.6 billion, up about 315% year over year.
Wall Street analysts projected Micron's FY2027 Q1 EPS at approximately $35.07, up about 634% year over year.
UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri forecast that Micron's open-market memory prices would begin declining in the second half of calendar 2028.
UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri reiterated a $1,625 Micron price target and Buy rating.
facts.subject_time: Analyst price target and rating outlook

facts.proposition: UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri forecast Micron FY2026 Q4 revenue of approximately $52.4 billion and EPS of approximately $32.50, above company guidance.

UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri forecast that Micron could begin repurchasing approximately $20 billion of shares per quarter after December 9, 2026, increasing toward approximately $50 billion per quarter by the end of fiscal 2027, conditional on restrictions expiring and cash generation supporting the plan.
UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri wrote that his latest checks indicated Micron's memory supply-demand gap was continuing to widen.
UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri forecast that Micron's profits would remain above current levels even after memory prices begin declining, supported by share buybacks and strategic pricing agreements.
facts.subject_time: Memory-price downturn beginning in the second half of calendar 2028

facts.proposition: Citi analyst Atif Malik forecast Micron FY2026 Q4 revenue of approximately $51 billion and EPS of approximately $31.45.
Citi analyst Atif Malik forecast Micron FY2027 Q1 revenue of approximately $57 billion and EPS of approximately $35.25.
Citi analyst Atif Malik forecast Micron's consolidated DRAM average selling price would rise 20% sequentially in FY2026 Q4 and another 13% sequentially in following quarters.
Citi analyst Atif Malik expected DRAM and NAND to remain undersupplied, with price growth slowing over the next four quarters and peaking around Q2 2027.
facts.subject_time: Current memory-price cycle through approximately Q2 2027

facts.proposition: Citi forecast Micron FY2027 capital expenditure of approximately $50 billion, including more than $20 billion of equipment spending.
BofA Securities said Micron's forthcoming gross-margin guidance could shape the stock's next move.
BofA Securities said Micron's forthcoming capital-spending guidance could shape the stock's next move.
Susquehanna expects Micron's November-quarter outlook to satisfy investors.
Susquehanna believes the full benefit of an Nvidia product ramp may be realized after Micron's November quarter rather than immediately.

BofA analyst Vivek Arya forecasts that Micron could maintain gross margins in the mid-80% range for fiscal 2027 if AI capital spending remains durable, supporting annual EPS estimates of approximately $150 to $200.
Vivek Arya forecasts Micron fiscal 2027 capital spending of approximately $40 billion to $50 billion.
Rosenblatt Securities expects Micron's average DRAM and NAND selling prices to rise approximately 10% sequentially in the November quarter.
Rosenblatt analyst Kevin Cassidy maintained a Buy rating and a $1,500 price objective for Micron Technology.
Wolfe Research analyst Chris Caso maintained a Buy rating and a $1,500 price objective for Micron Technology.
Kevin Cassidy forecast that Micron's strategic client agreements could represent approximately 40% of manufacturing bits within the next three to five years.
Analyst consensus forecast Micron FY2027 revenue would grow 90% to approximately $247.5 billion.
Analyst consensus forecast Micron FY2027 EPS would grow 116% to approximately $158.93.
An unnamed five-star analyst projected approximately 80% upside for Micron shares, arguing that AI memory demand could challenge an older Wall Street assumption.
Micron was described as posting earnings-per-share growth above 1,000% in 2026.
Analysts expected Micron revenue to rise nearly fivefold for the upcoming reporting period.
Analysts expressed skepticism about Micron's ability to meet memory demand ahead of its FY26 Q4 earnings report.
Morgan Stanley maintained an Overweight rating on Micron and a $1,200 price target, while expecting post-earnings estimate increases to be smaller than those seen after prior quarters.
facts.subject_time: FY26 Q4 earnings and subsequent estimate revisions

facts.proposition: A survey of 57 analysts placed Micron Technology's 12-month median price target at $1,600.
The article's author modeled an end-2026 Micron share price of approximately $2,490 using projected trailing-twelve-month EPS of $103.76 and a 24x earnings multiple.
Baird raised its Micron price target from $1,280 to $1,520 and maintained an Outperform rating.
Wedbush analyst Matthew Bryson reiterated an Outperform rating on Micron and raised the price target from $190 to $230.
facts.subject_time: Wedbush valuation view reported on September 28, 2026

facts.proposition: Wedbush expected Micron to report strong fiscal fourth-quarter earnings amid favorable memory-pricing trends.
The article highlighted an analyst scenario implying approximately 90% upside for Micron shares and cited a $775 analyst price target.
Baird analyst Tristan Gerra forecast that agentic AI workloads would continue increasing server CPU demand into 2027.
Baird expected industrywide DRAM supply growth to slow in 2027 relative to 2026, potentially keeping the memory market tight and supporting pricing.
Baird expected Micron to benefit from higher high-bandwidth-memory margins in 2027.
D.A. Davidson analyst Gil Luria reiterated a $2,000 price target for Micron and maintained a strongly bullish view on the shares.
Analysts expected Micron's FY26 fourth-quarter revenue to be approximately $51.14 billion, with earnings per share rising more than tenfold year over year.
JPMorgan analyst Harlan Sur expects Micron to exceed Wall Street expectations of approximately $51.4 billion FY26 Q4 revenue, 86.2% gross margin, and $31.73 EPS.
facts.subject_time: Micron FY26 Q4 earnings report expected September 30, 2026

facts.proposition: Harlan Sur estimates Micron's Strategic Customer Agreements may cover more than 35% of forward bit production and that contracted volumes may already exceed 50%.
facts.subject_time: Micron forward production and SCA coverage

facts.proposition: Harlan Sur interprets Micron's moderating price increases as a strategic decision to preserve customer relationships and cement long-term SCA commitments rather than evidence of weakening demand.
Harlan Sur expects Micron management to raise its November-quarter outlook, citing stronger customer requirements, tighter memory availability expected during 2027, and continued HBM4 ramp progress.
Harlan Sur expects HBM supply to remain insufficient through 2028.
JPMorgan described Micron's setup as constructive, saying tight DRAM and NAND markets and resilient pricing could provide upside to revenue, gross margin, and earnings.
Creative Strategies CEO and principal analyst Ben Bajarin appeared on a Yahoo Finance video to discuss the metrics and trends he would watch ahead of Micron's FY26 Q4 earnings report.
facts.subject_time: Micron FY26 Q4 earnings report scheduled for September 30, 2026

facts.proposition: Wedbush reiterated an Outperform rating and a $1,400 price target for Micron.
Wedbush said memory pricing should be significantly better than Micron's guidance and raised its estimates just above the high end of prior guidance.
J.P. Morgan rated Micron Overweight with a $1,540 price target and expected another beat-and-raise on continued pricing momentum.

w1_events.known_event_summary: 2026-09-23..2026-09-29 Micron analyst response episode: analysts updated ratings, targets, earnings and pricing forecasts ahead of the September 30 release, including JPMorgan and Wedbush views on Q4 revenue, margins, SCA coverage, HBM supply and another beat-and-raise.
w1_events.title: Multiple analysts and Wall Street consensus updated Micron forecasts and ratings amid the memory-price cycle
